plan.name: v1.9.3-bridge-attestor-store
plan.info: Bridge mint attestors stored separately for stable gas

title: Upgrade: v1.9.3-bridge-attestor-store
summary:
This upgrade stores bridge mint attestors in separate KV entries so mint attestation records remain fixed-size.

Problem:
- Attestors were stored as a growing map inside BridgeMintAttestation
- When multiple validators attest in the same block, the map grows between simulation and execution
- This caused out-of-gas failures even after fee distribution moved to EndBlock

Changes:
- New store prefix: bridge_mint_attestors/{chain}/{burn_id}/{valoper}
- MsgBridgeAttestMinted writes one fixed-size attestor entry and updates aggregate power
- BridgeMintAttestation no longer persists the attestors map (constant size)
- Migration moves existing attestor maps into per-attestor keys and backfills ConfirmedBy
- Fee distribution failures are tracked and quarantined after 100 attempts
- Bridge status query exposes pending/failed/quarantined fee counts

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to the v1.9.3 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
